name: Western Paladin
description: A greedy and cruel paladin who commands fiercely loyal serpent warriors.

description_citations.text: Seventh Edition: card flavor text (Seventh Edition, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Western Paladin kills an advisor who imagined enough gold.
timeline.quote: "I have no need of fools who can imagine 'enough,'" he told the advisor's corpse.
